scenes.narration: Hey! Have you ever wondered why your money disappears so fast?
scenes.headline: WHERE DID IT GO?

scenes.narration: My friend thought saving was impossible. Then he found one simple idea.
Pay yourself first. Put a little aside on day one, every single month.
scenes.headline: PAY YOURSELF FIRST

scenes.narration: Small amounts grow quietly, and the habit grows with them.
scenes.headline: SMALL STEPS

scenes.narration: A year later, he was celebrating! What would you save for? Tell me in the comments.
scenes.headline: YOU CAN DO IT
